summary: Hillman Solutions Corp. (HLMN), through a wholly owned subsidiary, entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement on July 31, 2026, to acquire all outstanding equity interests of Kanebridge Corporation for approximately $315 million in aggregate consideration, subject to customary adjustments for cash, debt, working capital, and transaction expenses. Funding combines cash on hand, revolver draw, and a new $200 million term loan facility. Closing conditions include HSR expiration, reps warranty accuracy, and covenant compliance. Reps and warranties insurance secured. Expected to close around start of Q4 2026, with termination date October 29, 2026. Watch for FTC/DOJ clearance timeline and purchase-price adjustments impacting final value.
